required_behavior: Replace PlaceholderPolicy with the real policy: first to_worker (or out-of-scope) creates/revises a Task (kind experiment or work) and a persisted pending approval (survives backend restart; no auto-resend after restart); scope check is deterministic per C-D65 (same Task/goal; paths inside approved paths; experiment: same command/criteria/environment names/shell, only commit may differ); in-scope instructions record a derived approval (derived_from user decision, actor backend_scope_check, tool_call_id) and proceed; one active Task at a time (another -> held:another_task_active); retry limit 3 for experiment re-runs (CW-13 policy).

ui_v1 (contract + backend handling; the UI card itself is U5): state exposes approvals [{approval_id, task_id, revision, kind, summary, spec, diff_vs_approved, created_at}] and active task/run status; client requests approval_decide{approval_id, decision approve|reject} (approve records approve_scope + proceed as ONE user action, C-AC-29), pause{}, resume{reconciled:true} (pause/resume semantics wired in U3; here accept and forward to a hook). Additive, versioning rules respected; refusals with reasons.

Experiment Task run: on approval start TaskWorkflow with the PRODUCT host shell (add a shell= injection to workflow/run.py as a CW-10 delta, default path unchanged); start only when the host shell is user-owned at a clean prompt with no jobs, otherwise mark held:host_terminal_busy and retry when it becomes idle (no user keystrokes are ever overwritten); collect/judge -> report to manager; complete/fail run.

Free-work Task: on approval deliver the instruction to the worker (non-staged message) with the approved goal/paths; the worker works with its own tools and reports via to_manager (progress/done/blocked/answer/report); reports are delivered to the manager; done/blocked close or hold the Task; manager can send further in-scope to_worker instructions.
Rejection: the manager learns it via its next to_worker/tool result or a delivered notice (no run exists).
Unify delivery: all deliveries to an OMP (workflow staged deliveries and handoff messages) go through ONE serialized delivery path per target so two messages never race into the same OMP turn.
Journal/records: every decision with ids; environment variable values rejected.
acceptance: red->green tests (fake OMP/fake peers, no model): approval creation/persistence/restart, approve/reject via ui_v1 messages, derived approval table (commit-only change in scope, command change -> new approval, path outside -> new approval), one active Task, retry limit, experiment run with injected shell incl. idle-only start and held:host_terminal_busy, free-work deliver/report/done flow, rejection notice, single delivery path ordering

rules: No model prompts (scripted provider only, outbound blocked); OMP only with the Workbench home or a fake HOME; never read/print/copy/hash credential contents or other processes' environ; temp dirs only under /tmp; kill only PIDs you started; never touch ~/wb-urux-sandbox or the user's processes or configs; no commits, no graphify update.
